answer: Resist sybils by weighting trust on attestation-graph shape. Each identity is a vertex; attestations and referrals are edges. A farm erupts as a dense plume of new vertices around one parent, synchronized and cross-attesting - the signature the engine discounts. Trust counts only via independent paths: a newcomer gains weight after trust voyages through several disjoint established vertices, so clones vouching for each other add nothing. Attacker cost: escaping it demands sparse, unsynchronized, long-lived links to real strangers - the price of acting like separate agents, defeating farming.
